items.question: How did denial-rate reporting change after the May release, and what was the effect?
items.gold_answer: Release 2026.05.12 renamed claim states; the un-updated mart mapping let pend states fall through to denied_other, so every pend counted as a denial — Northside's draft showed 14.3% vs a true 8.2%. Fixed with mapping v2 (fail-loud default), backfill, and a per-release mart-vs-CARC reconciliation test. The metric definition itself never changed.
